sum: Nauticus Robotics, Inc. engages in the development of electric autonomous robotic solutions for subsea applications. The company offers Aquanaut, an autonomous underwater vehicle to collect high-resolution subsea data; Olympic Arm, an all-electric manipulator designed for a variety of intervention tasks on work class remotely operated vehicles; and ToolKITT, a software is platform agnostic. The company has strategic alliance with Leidos Holdings, Inc. to develop autonomous underwater systems for tackling complex missions. Nauticus Robotics, Inc. was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Webster, Texas.
ceo: Mr. John Willis Gibson Jr., B.Sc., BSc Geology, M.Sc., MSc Geology (President, CEO & Director)
